kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: 22 per-state ref frames (handoff Table 1 L185–L188: CMP-197 6, CMP-198 4, CMP-199 8, CMP-226 4); dark only; compact density.

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: Ruling of record Q2 / Q3 (2026-10-30): boards 09 / 10 live in the per-set file `E11-D05 ref frames`, page `E11-D05 ref frames`; boards 01–08 stay on page `E11-D05` (§0). CMP-196 MultiChartLinker is non-visual: no frame (Table 1).

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Static ref frames, never library components (`16` §10 item 4; spec §8 L358); each frame's plugin-data note names its state, its source line and the slots it binds.

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: Chart content is seeded synthetic data (seed 310), not a recorded series.

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: Ownership (`15` L2546, restated per `16` §10 item 3): a DOM overlay, aria-hidden — the DOM mirror and the live region carry the values; the engine draws the crosshair and pills under it (CMP-190); `26` owns input coalescing (one reposition per frame).

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: States (§8.6 L410; D10 L304, L320): follow · flipped left · flipped above · clear of last price · docked · overflow. Anchor = the crosshair intersection, default 16 px right / below; priority: the last-price line and pill are never covered.

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Tokens: slots color.chart.pill.text.inverse (= color.text.inverse), color.chart.crosshair (= color.crosshair), color.chart.grid.major (= color.border.default), color.chart.grid.minor (= color.grid.line), color.chart.pane.bg.default (= color.surface.canvas), color.chart.rule (= color.border.default), color.chart.axis (= color.text.tertiary) — pending #390, the alias bound; box color.surface.overlay + color.border.default, radius.card, elevation.popover; title and labels color.text.secondary, values color.text.primary, type.num.sm; pad space.inset.sm.

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: Density (§6 L288; E11-D02 §2): compact drawn (the trading default) — axis type.num.sm 11 px, pills 17, chips 20, strip / rows 24, gutter = widest label + 8 (min 48), inset 8; comfortable 13 px / 20 / 24 / 32 / inset 12; dense 10 px / 16 / 20 / 24 / inset 4. Width 200–260 px compact, ≤ 40 % of the pane.

kids.name: value-5
kids.chars: Variants × States products: not drawn — the text is binding (ruling Q2; Table 1's Variant column). Variants: mode follow / docked / off ('off' draws no box: the legend is the readout).

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: Ownership (`15` L2559): engine only — the pane fill and the SDF watermark in the axis batch, aria-hidden (symbol and interval live in the toolbar and the canvas label); the pane fill never changes on focus (the D14 bar carries focus).

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: States (§8.7 L416; D13 L347): default · replay suffix · hidden below 120 px · dense 40 px. Centred in the price pane only, width ≤ 60 % of the plot, opacity fixed at 1.

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Tokens: slots color.chart.watermark (= color.border.default), color.chart.grid.major (= color.border.default), color.chart.grid.minor (= color.grid.line), color.chart.pane.bg.default (= color.surface.canvas), color.chart.rule (= color.border.default), color.chart.axis (= color.text.tertiary) — pending #390, the alias bound; type: 48 / 40 px semibold, no token: display / heading-lg (Fallbacks); the volume pane's bars color.candle.wick.

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: Density (§6 L288; E11-D02 §2): compact drawn (the trading default) — axis type.num.sm 11 px, pills 17, chips 20, strip / rows 24, gutter = widest label + 8 (min 48), inset 8; comfortable 13 px / 20 / 24 / 32 / inset 12; dense 10 px / 16 / 20 / 24 / inset 4. Watermark 48 px compact, 40 px dense; hidden below 120 px (160 comfortable).

kids.name: value-5
kids.chars: Variants × States products: not drawn — the text is binding (ruling Q2; Table 1's Variant column). Variants: none (dense 40 px is a state).

kids.name: value-1
kids.chars: Ownership (`15` L2572): a DOM overlay — the one home for per-series visibility toggles and cursor values (A-14; CMP-224 becomes the toolbar's entry); the engine draws the series it toggles; `26` §8 Pane.legend is PROPOSED (G14).

kids.name: value-2
